name: Copilot Settings
description: Windows MDM settings in the Copilot Settings category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Disable Agent Mode
properties.description: If this setting is enabled, it will prevent your users from using GitHub Copilot's Agent mode. For more information, see: https://aka.ms/CopilotGroupPolicy

properties.name: Disable Copilot
properties.description: If this setting is enabled, it will prevent your users from using any GitHub Copilot license (GitHub Copilot for Business, GitHub Copilot for Enterprise, and Copilot for Individual). For more information, see: https://aka.ms/CopilotGroupPolicy

properties.name: Disable Copilot for Individual
properties.description: If this setting is enabled, it will prevent your users from using GitHub Copilot for Individual. GitHub Copilot for Business and GitHub Copilot for Enterprise will still be enabled. For more information, see: https://aka.ms/CopilotGroupPolicy

properties.name: Disable Model Context Protocol (MCP)
properties.description: If this setting is enabled, it will prevent your users from using MCP for GitHub Copilot. For more information, see: https://aka.ms/CopilotGroupPolicy
